components.name: Button
components.description: Default raised control for any action.
components.css: .ds-btn{background:var(--surface-raised);color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:8px 10px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:transform var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out),border-color var(--dur-2) var(--ease-out),box-shadow var(--dur-2) var(--ease-out)}.ds-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent-line);box-shadow:var(--edge-accent);transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--ring)}.ds-btn:active{transform:scale(.975)}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled accent action, e.g. confirm or send.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; red-tinted at rest, filled on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger) 10%,var(--panel-2));color:var(--danger);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger) 45%,var(--border));border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:8px 10px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--dur-2) var(--ease-out),color var(--dur-2) var(--ease-out)}.ds-btn-danger:hover{background:var(--danger);color:var(--bg)}.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg),0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger) 78%,transparent)}

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sunken field for a single line of input.
components.css: .ds-input{background:var(--surface-sunken);color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:8px 10px;font:inherit;transition:border-color var(--dur-2) var(--ease-out),box-shadow var(--dur-2) var(--ease-out)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--fg-muted)}.ds-input:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 28%,var(--border))}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}

components.name: Card
components.description: The page's primary container around a wide work surface.

components.name: Menu Item
components.description: A row inside an app-bar drop-down panel.
components.css: .ds-menu-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:7px 9px;border:none;border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:transparent;color:var(--fg);font:inherit;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out),color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out)}.ds-menu-item:hover,.ds-menu-item:focus-visible{outline:none;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 15%,transparent)}.ds-menu-icon{flex:none;color:var(--fg-muted)}.ds-menu-item:hover .ds-menu-icon{color:var(--accent)}.ds-menu-key{margin-left:auto;padding:1px 6px;border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-xs);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 50%,transparent);color:var(--fg-muted);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6875rem}

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill that names a live run mode: recording, playback or chaos.

components.name: Terminal Screen
components.description: The 3270 character grid with its OIA status strip beneath.
components.html:
WELCOME TO 3270WEB
==>
X SYSTEM RUNNING

narrative.overview: 3270Web is a modern operator console that borrows the trust and legibility of a 3270 tube without imitating one literally. It is an Operate surface: the visitor is mid-task, often in a live host session, so the system favours scanability, predictable controls and honest state over expression. Personality comes from the phosphor palette, the monospace terminal face and precise hairline chrome. The visual system is a semantic token layer re-skinned by theme: colours, surfaces, borders and accents are declared once and overridden per theme, and components consume the tokens rather than hardcoding a palette.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic CSS custom properties per theme; no per-theme component CSS.
Phosphor accent used as an interaction signal, not as a large fill.
Inter for the interface, IBM 3270 for the character grid; tabular numerals.
Hairline borders and a four-step elevation ramp instead of heavy dividers.
A centred page shell around a wide, fixed-geometry terminal card.
State is always visible (recording, playback, chaos, live status).

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: New UI never writes a colour literal. Declare or consume a custom property; override the property on body.theme-* for a theme, never the component rule.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The accent is an interaction signal — focus, active, selected, live. It does not flood backgrounds or headings.

rules.name: The Lifted-Ink Rule
rules.body: Host blue text uses --term-color-blue, never pure blue, except in theme-authentic.

rules.name: The Weight Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Strong text and headings top out at 600; the browser's 700 default is never used for emphasis.

rules.name: The Grid Rule
rules.body: Terminal text never uses the UI font stack. It uses the mono faces with tabular numerals and no ligatures.

rules.name: The Terminal-Geometry Rule
rules.body: Never add horizontal padding, flex shrink or responsive reflow to .screen-container. Chrome belongs on .terminal-shell.

rules.name: The One-Bar Rule
rules.body: Session controls live in the app bar and its menus. Do not reintroduce floating panels over the terminal or a second toolbar row.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows lift real layers or respond to state.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Dividers are 1px translucent lines, not heavy borders and not extra shadows.

rules.name: The Square-Again Rule
rules.body: Where a theme asks for authenticity, radius goes to 0 for the terminal and card.

dos: Do consume semantic custom properties and declare anything new on body so it resolves against the active theme.
Do keep the terminal on its fixed character grid and put chrome on the parent shell.
Do use --fg-muted for secondary text and reserve --accent for interaction and live state.
Do keep focus visible with the shared --ring and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep destructive actions danger-coloured and non-destructive closes neutral.
donts: Don't hardcode hex values, shadows or radii in a component; that breaks every theme.
Don't use font weights above 600 for emphasis.
Don't add horizontal padding or flex shrink to .screen-container, or reflow the terminal for small screens.
Don't reintroduce floating toolbars over the terminal or a second control row beside the app bar.
Don't fill large areas with the accent; its rarity is what makes state legible.
Don't round the corners of the authentic/custom terminal or card themes.
